recommendation: Follow up in the Kindling/publisher code so generated CapabilityStatement-base uses the actual OperationDefinition.url/id casing from loaded OperationDefinition resources, and add or restore validation that catches unresolved case-sensitive canonical references. After that external change, rebuild the FHIR spec and verify capabilitystatement-base.xml/json matches package OperationDefinition canonicals.
issue_request: FHIR-12577 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core DSTU2 correction asking that generated complete CapabilityStatement OperationDefinition references preserve the case of case-sensitive OperationDefinition ids, and asking why the mismatch was not an error.
initial_application: The historical application is git commit 2c62cd190b768ad0d0494a401c7d1da0c18c6543, tagged '#12577 - check URL references are correct' and SVN revision 11519. It added or adjusted URL-reference checking and made broad reference cleanups, while noting in the subject that the check was turned off because too many references remained.
additional_context: Current source files such as source/resource/operationdefinition-Resource-validate.xml, source/resource/list-Resource-operations.xml, source/structuredefinition/operationdefinition-StructureDefinition-snapshot.xml, and source/structuredefinition/list-StructureDefinition-operations.xml use Resource-validate and StructureDefinition-snapshot casing. The current build package at https://build.fhir.org/hl7.fhir.r6.core.tgz contains OperationDefinition-StructureDefinition-snapshot.json with url http://hl7.org/fhir/OperationDefinition/StructureDefinition-snapshot, while CapabilityStatement-base.json references http://hl7.org/fhir/OperationDefinition/structuredefinition-snapshot. The repo build delegates generation to org.hl7.fhir:kindling:1.25.5-SNAPSHOT and org.hl7.fhir.tools.publisher.Publisher, so the generator implementation is outside this source checkout.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. No source files were edited because changing checked-in OperationDefinition ids to lower case would be a broad canonical URL change and would conform source to the generator bug rather than fixing generated CapabilityStatement-base to reference existing canonical OperationDefinition URLs.
